title: ForensicAI-Engine Feature Vector v1
description: One-per-incident summary that the Phase 5 AI triage model consumes. Locked contract — adding/removing/renaming features requires bumping the version. Features are scope-agnostic: Linux-only features (e.g. suid_additions) are zero on Windows incidents and vice versa, so the same model can score either scope.

log_lines_total.description: Total OCSF events across all artifacts. Proxy for collection completeness.

log_window_hours.description: Span between earliest and latest event time, in hours. Bundles span ~ a few hours of real activity to several days of background logs.

auth_failure_ratio.description: auth_failure_count / (auth_failure_count + auth_success_count). 0 if no auth events.

unique_src_ips.description: Distinct source IPs across all class_uid=3002 events (parsed from message field for sshd; from EventData for evtx).

offhours_logins.description: Successful logon events (3002, status_id=1, activity_id=1) outside 08:00–18:00 host-local.

new_user_creations.description: Count of user-creation auth events: sshd useradd lines on Linux, Windows EventID 4720, or Windows.Sys.Users entries newer than baseline.

elevated_process_count.description: 1007 events whose unmapped.is_privileged is true (Windows TokenIsElevated or Linux SUID-flagged exec).

suspicious_proc_count.description: Process events whose cmd_line contains known LOLBin patterns (certutil, bitsadmin, regsvr32 /s /u, mshta, rundll32 javascript:).

powershell_obfuscation_count.description: Process events (1007) OR shell-history events (6004 with source_step in {bash_history, powershell_history}) matching obfuscation markers: `frombase64string`, `iex (new-object`, `-w hidden`, backtick-noise.

encoded_command_count.description: Events whose cmd_line OR message contains `-encodedcommand`, `-enc`, or `EncodedCommand`.

unique_remote_ips.description: Distinct dst_endpoint.ip values across class_uid=4001 events (excluding 0.0.0.0 / 127.* / ::).

listen_port_count.description: Distinct local ports with class_uid=4001 activity_id=7 (LISTEN).

dns_query_count.description: class_uid=4001 events with unmapped.event_id=22 (Sysmon DNS) — Linux currently 0.

connections_to_threat_intel_ip.description: Subset of class_uid=4001 events whose dst_endpoint.ip matches a MISP IP IOC.

suid_additions.description: 1001 events with unmapped.is_privileged=true (SUID-flagged files). Linux only — zero on Windows incidents.

system_file_modifications.description: 1001 events whose actor.process.file.path starts with /etc, /usr/bin, /usr/sbin, C:\Windows, or C:\Program Files.

new_persistence_entries.description: Sum of cron_entries_added + service_installs + startup_items_added — aggregate persistence signal.

registry_run_key_changes.description: Sysmon Event 13 events (registry value set) whose target path is under a Run/RunOnce/StartupApproved key, OR startup_items rows. Linux always 0.

service_installs.description: 6004 events whose unmapped.event_id=7045 (Windows service install) OR source_step=systemd with severity_id=4.

ioc_hash_matches.description: Count of distinct process/file SHA256 hashes seen in MISP.

ioc_ip_matches.description: Count of distinct dst_endpoint.ip values seen in MISP.

ioc_domain_matches.description: Count of distinct DNS query hostnames seen in MISP. Linux currently 0 (no DNS source).

ioc_match_threat_levels_max.description: Highest MISP threat_level_id seen across all matched IOCs. 1=High 2=Medium 3=Low 4=Undefined, 0=no matches.

unique_yara_rules_matched.description: Distinct unmapped.yara_rule values across all 2004 events.

sysmon_high_severity_count.description: class_uid=2004 events from source_step=sysmon (Sysmon EID 8 CreateRemoteThread + EID 10 ProcessAccess — credential-dump and injection signals). Windows only — Linux always 0.

technique_ids.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs fired during simulation. Empty list when the incident has no simulation manifest (real incident or benign baseline).

is_benign.description: True if technique_ids is empty AND the bundle came from a deliberate benign-baseline run. False for simulated attacks and for unlabeled real incidents.
